items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] After you left Kidney, you went to Piron's band?

ctx.x: After you left Kidney, you went to Piron's band? I mean to Pitebuka's band.
Yeah. After you left Kidney, you went to Piron's band.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Wasn't that in your song?
